.github/workflows/build.yml.historicalHeader:
on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      upstream_version:
        description: "RustDesk upstream version to fork from (empty = branding/branding.env)"
        required: false
        default: ""
      only:
        description: "Comma list of platform jobs to run: linux,macos,windows (empty = all). Saves CI minutes on partial rebuilds."
        required: false
        default: ""
      publish_r2:
        description: "Publish the build to the live customer download bucket"
        required: true
        type: boolean
        default: false
      collect_windows_preflight_failure:
        description: "Continue a failed Windows source preflight for unpublished diagnosis; the original failure still blocks release"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      runtime_windows_release_gate:
        description: "Debugger-free actual signed Windows QuickSupport95 gate (requires artifact run and publish=false)"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      runtime_artifact_run:
        description: "Read-only runtime diagnostic using an existing signed payload run (empty = build)"
        required: false
        default: ""
      runtime_linux_artifact_run:
        description: "Artifact-only native Linux session diagnostic using an existing customer DEB run (empty = build)"
        required: false
        default: ""
      runtime_macos_artifact_run:
        description: "Artifact-only macOS runtime diagnostic using an existing signed DMG run (empty = build)"
        required: false
        default: ""

.github/workflows/pc01-linux-controller..prefix: name: Private attended PC01 Linux controller

      - '.github/workflows/pc01-linux-controller.yml'
      - 'scripts/pc01-linux-controller.py'
      - 'scripts/test-pc01-linux-controller.py'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      admission_json:
        description: Root-reviewed current070 admission JSON; no credentials
        required: true

.github/workflows/preflight.yml.historicalHeader:
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      receiver_native_only:
        description: 'Diagnostic exact receiver component only; never qualifies an application release'
        type: boolean
        default: false
      windows_source_runner:
        description: 'Windows source-only comparison runner'
        type: choice
        default: windows-2022
        options:
          - windows-2022
          - windows-2025
      portable_standard_lease_qa_bundle:
        description: 'Compile a GUID-only portable desktop QA fixture; does not qualify standard-user consent or release readiness'
        type: boolean
        default: false
      standard_gui_connection_observation:
        description: 'Observe isolated standard-child GUI initialization A/B/A; preserves native outcomes and never qualifies consent or applications'
        type: boolean
        default: false

      session_directory_access_observation:
        description: 'Disposable CI-only session directory DACL experiment; original Standard gate remains fatal'
        type: boolean
        default: false
